description: This source file defines a utility/helper class for managing tax groups in the Fineract system's integration tests. It includes methods to create tax groups, generate JSON payloads, and construct tax component mappings, with deprecated methods indicating transition towards a client library.

classes.name: TaxGroupHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to create and manage tax groups for Fineract integration testing.

methods.name: createTaxGroup
methods.description: Creates a tax group via server POST request using provided request and response specifications, and a collection of tax component IDs.

methods.name: getTaxGroupAsJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON string representing a tax group with given tax component IDs, including random name and fixed date/locale.

methods.name: getTaxGroupComponents
methods.description: Builds a list of tax component maps from a collection of tax component IDs.

methods.name: getTaxComponentMap
methods.description: Creates a map with tax component ID and fixed start date, representing a single tax component.

methods.name: createTaxGroup
methods.description: Creates a tax group by invoking the client library with a request object, returning the response.
